title: Thể thao tinh hoa hay phong trào · Advantages / Disadvantages
prompt: In some societies, prioritising community sports facilities over elite athletic programmes is being considered. Do the advantages of this approach outweigh the disadvantages?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Public sports budgets can fund everyday participation or concentrate resources on a small number of exceptional competitors. I favour giving community facilities priority, while retaining elite funding that demonstrably improves coaching or access beyond the national team. On balance, I judge the benefits greater under these limits.

Community provision can spread the benefits of physical activity widely. Affordable nearby facilities make regular participation easier than occasional inspiration from televised success. A public swimming pool could serve children, older residents and disabled users throughout the week. A regularly used pool can offer repeated health and social benefits across age groups, rather than concentrate public value in a small number of highly trained competitors. A televised victory may inspire interest, but regular participation still depends on affordable facilities, suitable sessions and practical access for different users.

Removing elite support may weaken coaching pathways and national competitive opportunities. Elite programmes may support specialist coaches and progression routes used by wider sporting communities. Removing them indiscriminately can weaken those connections, so a larger community budget does not automatically compensate for every lost function in the development system. Budgets should protect broad access while supporting elite programmes with demonstrable wider benefits. Elite spending should identify links such as coach development or accessible training pathways, making wider benefit something to demonstrate rather than merely invoke. Budgets should compare sustained community use with demonstrable benefits from elite programmes, rather than assume that medals automatically translate into a healthier population. Repeated use by many residents generally offers greater public value than medals alone, although losing shared coaching pathways would reduce that advantage.
Community access should receive the larger claim on public resources, with elite programmes earning continued support through concrete benefits that ordinary participants can also use.

review: Task Response: Kết luận phải trả lời bên nào nặng hơn và tại sao. Một rủi ro khắc phục được khác với một tổn thất nghiêm trọng khó đảo ngược. Đã xử lý phản biện “Removing elite support may weaken coaching pathways and national competitive opportunities.” chưa?
